# payload-onpage

> On-page editing and draft previews for Payload CMS on Next.js (App Router) and TanStack Start. Editors click text, images and sections on the live page and edit them in place. Changes autosave as Payload drafts through Payload's REST API, so access control, hooks, validation, drafts and versions apply. Signed, expiring, page-scoped share links preview drafts for anyone. Visitors pay about 0.3 KB.

Packages: `@payload-onpage/plugin` (Payload plugin), `@payload-onpage/next` (Next adapter: `<OnPage />`, `onpageContext()`, `isDraftEnabled()`, proxy), `@payload-onpage/tanstack-start` (Start adapter: `<OnPage />`, `onpageContext()`, `isDraftEnabled()`, no proxy), `@payload-onpage/react` (editor UI, annotations, client mode), `@payload-onpage/core` (framework-free ports and logic), `@payload-onpage/lexical` (rich text).

Integration in four edits (Next.js; Start differs only in the adapter import and has no proxy step):
1. `onpage({ collections, globals, session: nextSession() })` in payload.config.ts (`tanstackSession({ secret })` on Start)
2. `<Suspense><OnPage /></Suspense>` in the frontend root layout
3. `...(await onpageContext())` in draft reads that feed pages, plus `isDraftEnabled()` for draft checks
4. `proxy.ts`: `export const proxy = createOnPageProxy({ secret: process.env.PAYLOAD_SECRET })` (Next.js only)
